Staff Report
6B.

Staff Report
6C.
Community Services – Appoint Members of the 2025-2026 Torrance Youth Council. Expenditure: None.
Staff Report
6D.
Community Services – Torrance Art Museum’s Exhibition Opening August 23, 2025: SUR BIENNIAL
6C.
Community Services – Appoint Members of the 2025-2026 Torrance Youth Council. Expenditure: None.
7.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comments on items under the Consent Calendar or items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..
8A.
SECOND AND FINAL READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 3953
Second and Final Reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3953 amending Sections 13.1.1(c), 13.2.1, 13.3.1, 13.4.1, 13.5.1, 13.9.1, 13.10.1, 13.11.1, 13.15.1, 13.16.1, 13.18.1, 13.20.010, and 13.21.020 all titled “Created, Composition, Compensation, and Qualifications” of the Torrance Municipal Code relating to Compensation of Commissioners and approval of the Ordinance Summary for publication. This item is for consideration of adoption of the ordinance only. The item was previously discussed, and action was taken at a prior council meeting.
Staff Report
8B.
SECOND AND FINAL READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 3954
Second and Final Reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3954 amending Torrance Municipal Code Chapter 2, Article 2 of Division 9 by amending Section 92.2.10; and amending Chapter 2, Article 2 of Division 9 by deleting Section 92.2.11 regarding junior accessory dwelling units and approval of the Ordinance Summary for publication. This item is for consideration of adoption of the ordinance only. The item was previously discussed, and action was taken at a prior council meeting.
Staff Report
8C.
Measure SST Citizens’ Oversight Committee and Finance – Accept and File Fiscal Year 2024-25 Measure SST Citizens’ Oversight Committee Annual Report. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Measure SST Citizens’ Oversight Committee and Finance Director that City Council accept and file the fiscal year 2024-25 Measure SST Citizens’ Oversight Committee annual report.
Staff Report
8D.
Community Services — Approve Second Amendment to Contract Services Agreement for Encampment Prevention Overnight Security Guard Services. Expenditure: Not-to-Exceed $200,000 (General Fund-Measure SST Fund).
Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council approve a second amendment to the contract services agreement with Absolute International Security, Inc. of Irwindale, CA (C2023-124), in the amount of $200,000, for a new not-to-exceed amount of $619,912.32, to provide encampment prevention overnight security guard services at various city parks and facilities and extend the contract term for a one-year period beginning September 12, 2025 and ending September 11, 2026.
Staff Report
8E.
Community Services – Approve Second Amendment to Contract Services Agreement for
Shelf-Ready Library Materials. Expenditure: Not-to-Exceed $80,000 (General Fund).
Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council approve a second amendment to the contract services agreement with Ingram Library Services, LLC of La Vergne, TN (C2020-070), in the amount of $80,000, for a new not-to-exceed amount of $980,000, to provide shelf-ready library materials.
Staff Report
8F.
Community Services – Authorize Torrance Youth Council to Conduct an Annual Workshop at THE ATTIC, a Torrance Teen Center. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council authorize the Torrance Youth Council to conduct their annual workshop on Monday, August 25, 2025, at THE ATTIC, a Torrance Teen Center located at 2320 West Carson Street.
Staff Report
8G.
Public Works – Approve Third Amendment to Agreement for Usage of Recycled Water at the Torrance Refinery. Expenditure: Not-to-Exceed $6,000,000 (Non-General Fund).
Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council approve a third amendment to a tri-party agreement (C2021-027) with the Torrance Refining Company, LLC (TORC) of Torrance, CA and West Basin Municipal Water District for an additional amount of $6,000,000 in Fiscal Year 2025-26, for a new not-to-exceed amount of $46,000,000, for the usage of recycled water at the TORC Refinery during the contract period, which extends the contract term for an additional five-month period beginning
September 1, 2025 and ending January 31, 2026.
Staff Report
8H.
Fire – Accept and Appropriate 2024 Urban Area Security Initiative (UASI) Grant Program Subrecipient Agreement and Associated Funding. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Fire Chief that City Council accept and appropriate the Fiscal Year 2024 Urban Area Security Initiative (UASI) Grant Program award in the amount of $458,032.
Staff Report
8I.
General Services – Approve Agreement to Promote Torrance Cultural Arts Center. Expenditure: $338,800 (General Fund: $169,400 Annually).
Recommendation of the General Services Director that City Council approve an agreement with the Torrance Cultural Arts Foundation of Torrance, CA, in the amount of $338,800, to promote the Torrance Cultural Arts Center for a two-year period beginning July 1, 2025 and ending June 30, 2027.
Staff Report
9.
HEARINGS
9A.
Planning Commission and Community Development – Conduct Public Hearing and Adoption of RESOLUTIONS For Denial of an Appeal of the Planning Commission’s Approval of Conditional Use Permits (CUP24-00012, CUP24-00013) to Allow the Construction of Two Industrial Buildings Totaling 276,300 Square Feet on a 14.02-Acre Site, in Conjunction with a Division of Lot (DIV24-00004) to Consolidate Three Existing Parcels into Two Parcels, and Adoption of Mitigated Negative Declaration (EAS24-00001) on Property Located in the Heavy Manufacturing District (M-2 Zone) at 2160 West 190th Street (APNs 7352-016-001, 7352-016-002, and 7352-016-003); and Deny the Appeal, Adopt RESOLUTIONS, Upholding the Planning Commission’s Actions, and Affirming the Adoption of Mitigated Negative Declaration (EAS24-00001). Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Planning Commission and Community Development Director that City Council:
1.
Conduct public hearing; and
2.
Deny the appeal; and
3.
Adopt RESOLUTIONS denying the appeal and upholding the Planning Commission's approval of CUP24-00012, CUP24-00013, and DIV24-00004, and affirming the adoption of a Mitigated Negative Declaration (EAS24-00001), in accordance with Division 9, Chapter 5, Article 1 and Division 9, Chapter 2, Article 29 of the Torrance Municipal Code (TMC), to allow the construction of two industrial buildings totaling approximately 276,300 square feet on a 14.02-acre site and the consolidation of three existing parcels into two.
Staff Report
9B.
Planning Commission and Community Development – Conduct Public Hearing and Consider Adoption of RESOLUTION for Denial of an Appeal of Planning Commission’s Approval of Conditional Use Permit (CUP24-00028) and Development Permit (DVP24-00004) on Property Located within the Hawthorne Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan-Del Amo Business Sub District Two
(H-DA2 Zone) at 3475 Torrance Boulevard (APN 7524-014-110) and Determine a Categorical Exemption From the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Planning Commission and Community Development Director that City Council:
1.
Conduct a public hearing; and
2.
Deny the appeal; and
3.
Adopt a RESOLUTION denying the appeal and upholding the Planning Commission's approval of CUP24-00028 and DVP24-00004 as provided for in Division 9, Chapter 5, Article 1 and Division 9, Chapter 2, Article 36 of the Torrance Municipal Code (TMC) to allow the demolition of the existing medical office building and the construction of a new mixed-use development consisting of 106 residential units and 12,226 square feet of medical office floor area, on property located in the Del Amo Business District (H-DA2 Zone) ; and
4.
Determine a Categorical Exemption from California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); Article 19, Section 15332 (In-Fill Development).
Staff Report
9C.
Planning Commission and Community Development – Conduct a Public Hearing and Consider Adoption of RESOLUTION for the Denial of a Modification (MOD23-00010) of a Previously Approved Division of Lot (DIV14-00006) to Amend an Open Space Easement (Note A) for Purposes Related to Solar Panels and Associated Equipment and Perimeter Fencing, on Property Located within the Hillside Overlay in the Open Area – Planting – Parking District (P-1) Zone at 2550 Pacific Coast Highway and Determine a Statutory Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Planning Commission and Community Development Director that City Council:
1.
Conduct a public hearing; and
2.
Adopt a RESOLUTION for the denial of MOD23-00010 of previously approved DIV14-00006 to amend an open space easement (Note A) for purposes related to solar panels and associated equipment and perimeter fencing, on property located within the Hillside Overlay in the P-1 Zone at 2550 Pacific Coast Highway; and
3.
Determine a Statutory Exemption for denial of MOD23-00010 in accordance with the Guidelines for Implementation of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); Article 18, Section 15270 (Projects Which Are Disapproved).
Staff Report
recess
reconvene

ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS
10A.
Community Development – Request to Set Date for a Public Hearing on Proposed Local Amendments to the 2025 California Building Code. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Community Development Director that City Council set the date of September 9, 2025 for a public hearing to consider a proposed Urgency Ordinance and regular Ordinance adopting the 2025 California Building Code with Local Amendments.
Staff Report
10B.
Community Services – Accept and File Columbia Park Community Engagement and Concept Design Project Report. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council accept and file the Columbia Park Community Engagement and Concept Design Project Report.
Staff Report
11.
AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled.
12.

Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
RECONVENE
14.
ADJOURNMENT Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, September 09, 2025, at 5:00 p.m. for closed session with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the LeRoy J. Jackson Council Chamber.
Tuesday, August 26, 2025 and Tuesday, September 02, 2025 are City Council Dark Nights.
